# Vendored: do not edit

The files beside this note are a copy of `mipc-client` 2.0.0, generated by
its `tools/vendor.py`. Editing them here is lost on the next sync, and CI fails
on it. Change the client in its own repository, then refresh this copy:

```sh
cd ../mipc-client
python tools/vendor.py /home/ness/projects/busychild77/mipc-restream/src/mipc_client
```
